# wellplayed_organization_attached_app (Resource)

Attaches an application to the organization and assigns it a permission group (and optional member-specific permissions). This is the app-side counterpart of `wellplayed_iam_member`: it places an app — rather than a user — into an IAM group. Backed by the `setOrganizationAttachedApp` and `deleteOrganizationAttachedApp` mutations and the `organizationAttachedApps` query.

Each resource owns exactly one `app_id`; that field is immutable and changing it forces replacement.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A permission group the app will be assigned to.
resource "wellplayed_iam_group" "bots" {
  name = "Service Bots"

  permissions {
    id        = "tournament:read"
    resources = ["*"]
  }
}

# Attach an application to the organization and place it in the group above.
resource "wellplayed_organization_attached_app" "scoreboard" {
  app_id   = "app_01h..."
  group_id = wellplayed_iam_group.bots.id
}

# Attach an app with extra, app-specific permissions on top of (or instead of)
# a group.
resource "wellplayed_organization_attached_app" "importer" {
  app_id = "app_02h..."

  permissions {
    id        = "tournament:write"
    resources = ["tournament_123"]
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_id` (String) Identifier of the application to attach. Changing it forces a new attachment. This is the canonical identifier used for import.

### Optional

- `group_id` (String) ID of the permission group assigned to this attached app (see `wellplayed_iam_group`). Omit to attach the app without a group.
- `permissions` (Attributes Set) Permissions granted to this attached app beyond its group. Omit for none. Note: the API does not return permissions in a readable form, so this value is managed write-only from configuration and is not refreshed during Read; out-of-band changes to permissions are not detected as drift. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--permissions))

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the attachment was created (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) Identifier of the attachment. Equal to `app_id`.
- `organization_id` (String) ID of the organization this app is attached to.
- `updated_at` (String) When the attachment was last updated (RFC 3339).

<a id="nestedatt--permissions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `permissions`

Required:

- `id` (String) The permission identifier.
- `resources` (Set of String) Resource identifiers this permission is scoped to.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Attached apps are imported by their app ID.
terraform import wellplayed_organization_attached_app.scoreboard app_01h...
```
